# 公益財団法人東京都歴史文化財団 (Tokyo Metropolitan Foundation for History and Culture)

> > Official foundation managing Tokyo's major museums, art galleries, and cultural facilities including Tokyo Metropolitan Art Museum, Museum of Contemporary Art Tokyo, Tokyo Photographic Art Museum, and the Grutto Pass museum admission program.

The Tokyo Metropolitan Foundation for History and Culture operates over 15 cultural institutions across Tokyo, offering the Grutto Pass for discounted museum admission, digital cultural content through #CultureFromHome, and extensive arts education programs. The foundation also manages Arts Council Tokyo and supports emerging artists through residency programs.

## Key Topics

- 東京都美術館 (Tokyo Metropolitan Art Museum)
- 東京都現代美術館 (Museum of Contemporary Art Tokyo)
- 東京都写真美術館 (Tokyo Photographic Art Museum)
- 東京都庭園美術館 (Tokyo Metropolitan Teien Art Museum)
- 東京都江戸東京博物館 (Edo-Tokyo Museum)
- Grutto Pass (museum admission pass)
- アーツカウンシル東京 (Arts Council Tokyo)
- Tokyo cultural facilities
- Museum exhibitions and programs
- Arts education and workshops
- Digital cultural content
- Artist residencies
- #CultureFromHome online archive
- Cultural foundation support and donations

## Grutto Pass Museum Program

- [ご利用ガイド - 東京・ミュージアム ぐるっとパス2025](https://www.rekibun.or.jp/grutto/guide): Grutto Pass usage guide with QR code and electronic ticket info
- [使える施設一覧（港・渋谷・目黒・世田谷エリア）｜東京・ミュージアム ぐるっとパス2025](https://www.rekibun.or.jp/grutto/facilities/03): Grutto Pass participating facilities in Minato/Shibuya/Meguro/Setagaya
- [7～8月のおすすめ展覧会（割引） - 東京・ミュージアム ぐるっとパス2025](https://www.rekibun.or.jp/grutto/blog/20240627-5278): July-August recommended exhibitions with Grutto Pass discounts
- [9～10月のおすすめ展覧会（割引） - 東京・ミュージアム ぐるっとパス2025](https://www.rekibun.or.jp/grutto/blog/20240829-5401): September-October recommended exhibitions with Grutto Pass discounts
- [2～3月のおすすめ展覧会（入場） - 東京・ミュージアム ぐるっとパス2025](https://www.rekibun.or.jp/grutto/blog/20230925-4942): February-March recommended exhibitions with free Grutto Pass admission

## Arts & Culture Programs

- [東京こども芸術文化プラットフォーム「TOKYOカルチャーデビュー」](https://www.rekibun.or.jp/crossing/childrenscenter): Tokyo children's arts platform for cultural experiences & education
- [おうちでカルチャー #CultureFromHome](https://www.rekibun.or.jp/culturefromhome-list): Culture From Home digital archive of Tokyo museums' online content
- [アート・カルチャー体験100 – ページ3](https://www.rekibun.or.jp/hands_on_events/page/3): Art & culture hands-on experience events at Tokyo museums, page 3
- [アート・カルチャー体験100 – ページ4](https://www.rekibun.or.jp/hands_on_events/page/4): Art & culture hands-on workshops and programs, page 4
